name: fs_getfilep

ownership.argument: Astrolink calls this as F_FS_GETFILEP(fd, &file) to obtain a reference to the loop's pipe write end from its own task group.

provenance.source: Takes an fd and an out-parameter; resolves the calling task's file list through 0xC2055E8, bound-checks fd against 8 * rows, then indexes array[fd >> 3] + 32 * (fd & 7), requires inode at file+16 and a nonzero refcount at file+4, increments that refcount and returns the file. Consumer 0xC1CACE8 uses the returned file's inode type word at inode+14, and 30 call sites match the VFS read/write/ioctl wrappers.

notes: Astrolink calls this as F_FS_GETFILEP(fd, &file) to obtain a reference to the loop's pipe write end from its own task group.
